behavior: Consumes the original FunctionsHttpError.context Response once, without clone/tee or unbounded json().
Reuses readBoundedBytes with a 16384-byte cap and a 1000-ms monotonic stream deadline; cancellation is best effort and never awaited indefinitely.
Validates failed/partial/unknown, confirmed_inserted, legacy inserted agreement and row count. Malformed receipts remain unknown with no fabricated count.
Provider error strings and raw diagnostics are ignored; only locally defined French messages and validated numeric counts enter notifications.
Malformed successful-HTTP result envelopes are not announced as successful discovery.
Partial/unknown keep the draft and advise checking the list before retry; a current account/draft may refresh its list, without automatic discovery retry.
All account/epoch, draft revision, modal lifetime and synchronous admission protections remain in place.
Failure status must be an actual string; arrays and other coerced values stay unknown with no invented count.
ES2020 compatibility uses Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call. The legacy prospect-row return type is retained explicitly; full row fields are not certified by envelope validation.
limits: The 16 KiB/1 second cap covers decoding the SDK non-2xx error context body. Existing SDK invocation and successful-response transport are unchanged.

Tests use the real FunctionsClient/FunctionsHttpError, Response streams and actual React/Radix controls with controlled transports; no real provider, credential, network or database operation is certified.
No native browser, deployment, merge, migration, contact, campaign, commission or payment was executed in this subtask.
